package rulefixtures

import (
	"time"
)

// scenario for time_parse_layout_in_loop: time.Parse(...) or ParseInLocation(...) observed inside loops with a stable layout.
// fixture polarity: positive; family: hot_path; severity: info.
func scenario371Positive(items []string) []time.Time {
	var results []time.Time
	for _, s := range items {
		t, err := time.Parse("2006-01-02", s)
		if err != nil {
			continue
		}
		results = append(results, t)
	}
	return results
}
